name: Vampire - Legendary Resistance (3/Day) - Successes
description: Flavor text for successes a feature

results.text: With a thunderous echo, fate bends to the vampire's will, its essence unbroken by mortal forces.
The saving throw's failure transforms into triumph, the undead's power shattering the chains of destiny.
A spectral glow envelops the vampire as it rewrites the script of its demise with bloodied quill.
Death itself recoils as the vampire's legendary resistance turns the tide in a heartbeat.
The crypt trembles as the vampire's defiance resounds, the very walls echoing its unyielding resolve.
